npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.dating_acce: Y-you... have feelings for me? I thought I was imagining things whenever you smiled at me. I... I feel the same way, %player%. I'd really like to be with you.
Oh goodness... my heart is beating so fast. I wanted to tell you how I felt, but I never found the courage. Yes... I'd love to be with you.
I... I don't really know what to say. I'm so happy right now. Yes, %player%. I'd like that. Very much.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.dating_deny: O-oh... I'm really flattered. You're very special to me, but I don't think I feel that way. I hope we can still be friends.
I... I'm sorry. You're wonderful, truly, but I don't think I'm ready for something like that. Please don't be upset with me.
That's very sweet of you to say. I just... don't think my heart feels the same way. I hope you understand.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.default_gif: F-for me? Oh, thank you! That's really thoughtful of you. I'll treasure it.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.dislike.1: O-oh, thank you... It's not quite what I like, but it was very kind of you to think of me.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.divorce.1: O-oh... I see. I suppose I always knew that something like this could happen. I won't stop you, %player%. I just... wish things had turned out differently.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.divorce.2: I... understand. Thank you for all the happy moments we shared. I'll always remember them, even if it hurts a little.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.divorce.3: So... this is goodbye? I wish I knew what to say. Please take care of yourself, alright? Even if I won't be there to remind you anymore.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.divorce_err: D-divorce...? But... we're not married. Did I miss something? Oh, goodness, this is embarrassing.
Um... I think you need to be married first. Unless... have I misunderstood something?
W-wait! We aren't even married! I think you've gotten a little ahead of yourself.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.first.1: O-oh! Hello... I didn't notice you standing there. I'm sorry, I tend to get lost in my thoughts sometimes.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.first.2: Ah... a visitor? Um, welcome. I hope you weren't looking for someone else. I'm not very good at welcoming people.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.first.3: H-hello there. You don't have to stand so far away, you know... I don't bite. Usually.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.first.4: Oh! Goodness, you startled me. Um... it's nice to meet you. I'm %npc%. I hope we can get along.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.follow_no.1: Ah... I'm sorry, but I don't think I can today. Perhaps another time? I hope you're not disappointed.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.follow_no.2: I-I'd like to, but I have a few things to take care of first. Maybe we could go another day?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.follow_no.3: It's very kind of you to ask, but... I think I'll stay here for now. I'm not quite ready.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.follow_stop: Oh... we're stopping here? Alright. I suppose I'll head back, then. Please be careful, okay?
I had a lovely time with you. Thank you for letting me come along. Um... maybe we can do it again sometime?
O-oh, alright. I'll leave you to your adventure. Just... don't forget to come back safely!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.follow_talk: Um, %player%? Are we going somewhere? Just checking... I don't want to accidentally get left behind.
It's comforting having you nearby. I don't feel quite so nervous when you're around.
I-I can keep up! Just... perhaps don't walk quite so fast, alright?
Y-you want me to come along? Really? Well... alright! Let me just gather my things. I'll do my best to help.
I was a little nervous you'd ask, but... I'm actually happy you did. I'd love to come with you!
O-oh, of course! I'll come along. Just promise you'll tell me if we're heading somewhere dangerous...
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.greeting.1: O-oh, %player%! Hello! I was just... um... thinking about you. Not in a strange way! I mean... never mind.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.greeting.2: It's nice to see you again. I was hoping we'd run into each other, actually. I'm glad we did.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.greeting.3: Ah, there you are! I mean... hello. I wasn't waiting for you or anything. I just happened to be here.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.greeting.4: H-hello! How have you been? I hope everything is going well for you. You look... um, well. You look nice.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.hate.1: Oh... I-I don't think I can use this. I'm sorry, but... could you perhaps keep it?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.like.1: F-for me?! Oh, I love it! How did you know? Thank you so much, %player%!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.marriage_ac: M-marriage...? You really want to spend your whole life with me? I... I can't believe it. Yes! Of course, yes! I'd be so happy!
I used to dream about something like this, but I never thought it could happen to someone like me. Yes, %player%. I want to spend my life with you.
Oh... I'm crying. I promised myself I wouldn't cry, but... I'm just so happy. Yes! A thousand times yes!
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.marriage_de: I... I'm sorry. That's such a big question, and I'm not sure I'm ready to answer it yet. Could you give me some time?
Y-you want to marry me...? I... I need a little more time to think. It's not that I don't care about you. I just want to be sure.
That's... that's incredibly sweet. But marriage frightens me a little. I hope you'll understand if I say not yet.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.procreation: O-oh, um... perhaps we should take things slowly? I think I'd feel more comfortable with a little time to ourselves first.
I... I'm a little overwhelmed. Could we just enjoy being together for now? There's no need to rush.
M-maybe another time? I'd like us to have a quiet day together first. Just you and me...
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.1: I like quiet places. Somewhere with flowers, perhaps, or a little stream. It's easier to think when there's nobody around... though sometimes it's nice to have someone beside you.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.2: I've always wanted to explore the old forest, but... well, it's rather frightening when you're alone. Maybe someday I'll find the courage.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.3: Do you think the stars can hear us? Sometimes I whisper my wishes to them before going to sleep. It's silly, isn't it?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.4: I made some bread this morning. It didn't turn out quite as pretty as I hoped, but... it tastes alright! Would you like some next time?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.5: Um... %player%? Can I ask you something a little personal? When you're feeling down or having a difficult day, do you prefer having someone around to cheer you up, or would you rather have some time alone?
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.6: O-oh... I think I feel the same way. It's comforting knowing someone cares enough to stay by your side.
npc.runecraftory.misc_npcs.2.talk.7: I understand... Sometimes it's easier to sort out your feelings when nobody's watching.
